title: The Munsters

description:

description:

title: The Munsters
description:

description:

Grandpa creates a robot playmate for Eddie.

description:

title: The Munsters
description:

After an argument, Herman draws a line down the center of the house and orders Grandpa to stay on his side.

title: The Munsters
description:

Herman is mistaken for a dummy by a couple of fraternity boys, who cart him off to a sorority house.

title: The Munsters
description:

While obeying a "don't walk" sign, Herman gets hit by a car.

title: The Munsters
description:

Eddie's school essay about his family prompts a visit from the principal.

title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde

description:

description:
